req.title: Reflect query parameters on GET
req.statement: The system shall include client-supplied query parameters under the 'args' key of the GET /get response body.
expected_outcomes: response args field mirrors query string

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /get must reflect client-supplied query parameters under the 'args' key. I designed tests covering: (1) a positive EP case with a single k=v pair asserting exact key and value; (2) a positive EP case with multiple parameters; (3) a negative/NEG case with no query parameters asserting args is an empty dict; (4) a BVA case with a single-character key and empty-string value (boundary of minimal input); (5) a DT case verifying that args does NOT bleed into other top-level keys; (6) a BVA case with a parameter whose value contains special characters (URL-encoded); (7) a NEG case verifying that POST /post does not affect GET /get args isolation. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_get_single_query_param_reflected_in_args
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-002: args key mirrors query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_single_query_param_reflected_in_args():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'args' in body
    assert body['args'] == {'foo': 'bar'}

test_get_single_query_param_reflected_in_args()

tests.name: test_get_args_not_leaked_into_other_top_level_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: query param value does NOT appear in 'url' key as a standalone field
trace: R-HTTPBIN-002: args key is the sole location for query params; other keys must not duplicate them
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_args_not_leaked_into_other_top_level_keys():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get?x=99')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert set(body.keys()) == {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'origin'}
    assert body['args'] == {'x': '99'}
    assert 'x' not in body['headers']

test_get_args_not_leaked_into_other_top_level_keys()

tests.name: test_get_repeated_key_returns_list_or_last_value
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: args['k'] is either ['1','2'] (multi-value) or '2' (last wins) — not absent
trace: R-HTTPBIN-002: repeated query keys must appear under args; semiflatten returns list when count > 1
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_repeated_key_returns_list_or_last_value():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get?k=1&k=2')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'args' in body
    assert 'k' in body['args']
    val = body['args']['k']
    assert val == ['1', '2'] or val == '2' or val == '1'
    assert val != {}
    assert val is not None

test_get_repeated_key_returns_list_or_last_value()

import json

def test_get_response_content_type_is_json():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get?z=42')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type
    body = json.loads(r.data)
